text_block_list.text: While out shopping, spotted lively trio.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Badges, badges~♪ Stylish, cute, deco-deco 
pin badges~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hope there are lots of cute pin badges♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Feature article: 'Stand out with school 
bag accessories!' huh? Fashion sounds like 
lot of hard work~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Riding trends makes adult woman, right♪ 
Totally!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And right now, decorating bags with badges 
is super trendy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
'Fashion is customizing!' This magazine 
says good stuff!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Trends are great, but styling differently 
so you don't match other girls is key~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that! Total originality! Mmm, totally 
motivated now♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Maya-chan, Curren Chan~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying! Bono-chan, you're 
getting stylish with us too♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Since we went shopping together, wearing 
matching ones might be super cute too♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wah~! That sounds super fun♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then let's find super cute pin badges all 
of us can wear~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yeah~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And let's find original ones that won't 
clash with other girls~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yeah~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And then, let's customize like crazy and 
make most stylish bags ever~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Can we start looking already?

Customizing your own way matters. Same 
goes for fashion and running.
